# Make steam work
[textlink="Back to Mining & Industry" link="CMUGuideIndustry"]
## Your first powered chain
[bold]Pump on water → liquid pipe → fueled boiler → gas pipe → machine.[/bold]
- Carry portable equipment with [bold]both hands[/bold]. Click a reachable clear floor tile to place and anchor it. - Put a pump on suitable water. Dry ground is not a water supply. - Use a screwdriver on a [bold]liquid pipe[/bold], then its destination, to connect liquid ports. - Supply the boiler with water and fuel. Route its steam through [bold]gas pipes[/bold]. These are a different network from liquid pipes. - Put a drill over a deposit and leave room for its output. Presses, grinders and smelters use the same steam stage.
## Nothing happening? [bold]Check in this order:[/bold] anchored machine → source water and fuel → correct pipe network → required input or mold → output space.
A generator turns steam into electricity. A drill turns a deposit into resources. Pick the machine for the job, then keep it fed.
